card.name: Noun just before a stop/resume verb
card.fires_on: The last word of a noun phrase that is about to take a verb of ending or continuing, such as resolves, abate, passed, subsided or were eliminated. It also fires on object nouns in step-by-step handling instructions.

modes.label: Problem about to resolve
modes.description: Symptom or restriction noun right before a verb saying it resolves, abates or ends.
modes.example: Withhold until recovery to platelet count greater than 50 x 10 9 /L and<< bleeding>> resolves, then resume at the same dosage

modes.label: Device or item in instructions
modes.description: Equipment noun in a stepwise procedure, followed by an action verb or direction.
modes.example: Remove<< needle>>. 8. Mix contents of container

modes.label: Narrative illness or rule ending
modes.description: A noun in general prose about something that then passes or is removed.

card.writes: It nudges the model toward words like continue, disappears and change to, which fit what happens next to the noun.
card.plain: It marks a noun that is about to be followed by words saying it stops, clears up or carries on.
